title: Multiparameter Quantum Estimation and Degeneracy Structure in Three-Flavor Neutrino Oscillations
summary: We investigate three-flavor neutrino oscillations within the framework of quantum estimation theory using the quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM). We analyze all six independent elements of the QFIM for the parameters $θ_{23}$, $δ_{\mathrm{CP}}$, and $Δm^2_{31}$, together with the corresponding quantum Cramér--Rao bounds and normalized parameter correlations. To connect the intrinsic quantum sensitivity of the neutrino state with experimentally accessible information, we further compare the QFI with the classical Fisher information (CFI) associated with flavor-probability measurements.…
